description: Resolve a roost by `slug` or `hatchId`. Returns a compact view `{ hatchId, slug, url, apex, tier, state, expiresAt, customDomain, galleryListed }`. Use this to recover state across turns when the user mentions their site without giving you the hatchId. To see every hatch in a workspace, use `list` instead.

hatchId.description: Hatch id from the original hatch response.
